messages:
Marta Chen: Quick intake — ran an initial perf sweep for Zenith-9B (chat) on p4d-reserved cluster. Posting highlights, want prioritization guidance and checklist items.
Samir Patel: thanks — curious about int4 vs int8 tradeoffs here. any quality regressions noted? :eyes: 
Marta Chen: int4 quant pipeline ran with our usual calibration set (10k prompts). Small drop on helpfulness for instruction-following (~1.5% menurut eval), hallucination unchanged. Latency drop is nice.
Olivia Reed: can you paste the latency/throughput numbers? need to map to our SLA tiers.
Marta Chen: baseline fp16 single-replica (bs=1, ctx=2048): p95 latency 420ms, tok/s 180. int4 (same config): p95 320ms, tok/s 240. bs=8 batch throughput: fp16 1.2k tok/s, int4 1.7k tok/s.
Kai Nakamura: interesting. what's the memory delta? how many concurrent streams on a TBE?
Marta Chen: mem: fp16 38GB, int4 26GB. On p4d we can run 8 concurrent streams bs=1 comfortably for int4. fp16 hits memory cap at 6 streams.
perf-bot: run 1723456789-zenith9b-int4-sweep finished. artifacts: s3://redwood-perf/zenith9b/1723456789/ (latency.csv, quality.json, heatmap.png)
Samir Patel: can we get a heatmap of batch size vs ctx length? that will help routing policies.
Marta Chen: attached heatmap link in artifacts. quick notes: batching helps up to bs=16 for ctx<=1024; for ctx>8192 we see diminishing returns due to KV copying.
Olivia Reed: proposal: prioritize int4 for Dedicated tier (cost-sensitive) but keep fp16 Canary for Hosted to catch subtle quality regressions. Anyone opposed?
Kai Nakamura: +1. Also suggest a small A/B eval on 5k production prompts to validate end-to-end quality before rollout.
Samir Patel: checklist items I want before we mark as "onboard-ready":
- define target SLOs (p95 latency, tok/s) per tier
- run 5k evals comparing fp16 vs int4, capture distributional regressions
- run cold-start and KV-warmup tests (ctx sweep 128..16384)
- produce batching heatmap (bs 1,2,4,8,16,32) for ctx 256/1024/4096
- verify memory+OOM margins on Dedicated SKU (8 concurrent streams target)
- create rollback policy (model variant fallback + routing)
Marta Chen: added to my checklist. I'll kick off the 5k eval job and the cold-start warmup probe tomorrow morning.
BenchOps: scheduled p4d window 03:00-06:00 UTC for the large ctx sweep. Notifying infra to watch for throttles.
Marta Chen: awesome — will post results in this thread. If int4 quality delta >2% on any key metric we hold and do quant calibration re-run.
Samir Patel: cool. tagging @Olivia for prioritization decision — if infra cost delta below threshold, we can fast-track Dedicated int4.
Olivia Reed: sounds good. thanks team. :thumbsup:
